# HERA International

> > HERA International offers premium Korean beauty products including the Signia anti-aging line, foundations, UV protection, and signature fragrances like Velvet Night and Zeal.

HERA is a luxury cosmetics brand featuring advanced skincare solutions and makeup products. The site showcases their flagship Signia collection for anti-aging, comprehensive makeup lines for face, eyes, and lips, plus sun protection and fragrance offerings.

## Key Topics

- Signia anti-aging line
- UV protection & SPF50 sunscreen
- Premium skincare & cosmetics
- Foundation & cushion makeup
- Eye care & anti-aging treatments
- Velvet Night fragrance
- Zeal Eau de Parfum
- Black Cushion Foundation
- Sensual Powder Matte Liquid
- Signia Core Lifting Serum
- Hydro-dew plumping technology
- Sun protection products
- Cleansing & toner essentials
- Homme men's line

## Signia Premium Anti-Aging

- [Signia Collection](https://int.hera.com/collections/signia): Signia premium anti-aging line: ampoule, serum, cream & eye treatment
- [SIGNIA RECOVERY CONCENTRATE](https://int.hera.com/products/signia-recovery-concentrate): Signia 4-week intensive Narcis Peptide ampoule for radiant skin
- [SIGNIA SKIN REFINING WATER](https://int.hera.com/products/signia-skin-refining-water): Signia toner for bright, smooth complexion and healthy skin
- [SIGNIA YOUTH FIRMING EYE CREAM](https://int.hera.com/products/signia-youth-firming-eye-cream): Signia anti-aging firming eye cream for youthful appearance
- [Anti-Aging Collection](https://int.hera.com/collections/anti-aging): Anti-aging skincare: Signia Water, collagen cream & rejuvenating products

## Face Makeup

- [Face Collection](https://int.hera.com/collections/face): Face makeup collection: foundation, cushion, primer, powder & highlighter
- [SILKY STAY 24H LONGWEAR FOUNDATION](https://int.hera.com/products/silky-stay-24h-longwear-foundation): Silky Stay 24h foundation SPF20: radiant, flawless finish
- [Eyes Collection](https://int.hera.com/collections/eyes): Eye makeup collection: eyebrow, eyeliner, mascara & eye shadow products
- [Lip & Cheek Collection](https://int.hera.com/collections/lip-cheek): Multi-use lip & cheek makeup products for versatile application
- [ROUGE CLASSY](https://int.hera.com/products/rouge-classy): Rouge Classy lipstick: sophisticated colors with luxurious shine

## Skincare Essentials

- [Cleansing Collection](https://int.hera.com/collections/cleansing): Cleansing collection: oil, foam, water & makeup remover products
- [Toner / Water Collection](https://int.hera.com/collections/toner-water): Toner & water collection: Signia, Homme & Aquabolic skincare essentials
- [Eye Care Collection](https://int.hera.com/collections/eye-care): Eye care collection: anti-wrinkle creams & Signia eye treatment

## UV Protection & Sun Care

- [UV Protection Collection](https://int.hera.com/collections/uv-protection): UV protection skincare: Sun Mate sunscreen products with SPF
- [UV PROTECTOR MULTI-DEFENSE FRESH SPF50+](https://int.hera.com/products/uv-protector-multi-defense-fresh): Light-Fit moisturizing sun cream SPF50+ for makeup base
- [UV PROTECTOR MULTI-DEFENSE SPF50+](https://int.hera.com/products/uv-protector-multi-defense): Multi-functional daily sun cream SPF50+ with anti-aging benefits

## Fragrance

- [Velvet Night Collection](https://int.hera.com/collections/velvet-night): Velvet Night perfume: sensual floral with iris, violet & musk
- [ZEAL EAU DE PARFUM](https://int.hera.com/products/zeal-eau-de-parfum-for-women): Zeal women's perfume: musk & green floral for passion & confidence
